title: An RFQ email is not a quote request yet

linkedin.post:
An RFQ email usually leaves out the one thing I need to quote it.

A buyer writes, "Need 500 stainless fasteners, can you quote?" There is no size, no grade and no delivery date.

Someone on your team writes back with questions. The buyer waits for the next message.

I ask those questions in the conversation. Size, quantity and timeline come up in one chat, and your team gets a complete request.

Which detail does your team chase most often on a quote request?

See how it works:
https://chatsku.com/rfq-automation-for-product-catalogs/
